name: Catgirly Romantic Parody Gayme
source:
A panicky disaster lesbian wakes up in a cardboard box in a world entirely unfamiliar. Awawawa!

Two catgirls cosplaying as a hot mage and a cute knight find her and drag her to an inn. Awawawa, but in a good way! Unless that isn’t cosplay and this is actually a lousy RPG parody of some kind…

[From [url=https://lezliz.itch.io/catgirly-romantic-parody-gayme]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位惊慌失措的灾难女同性恋在一个完全陌生的世界的纸板箱里醒来。哇哇哇！

两个扮演性感法师和可爱骑士的猫女找到了她，并将她拖到了一家旅馆。阿瓦瓦瓦，但以一种很好的方式！除非这不是角色扮演，而且这实际上是某种糟糕的RPG模仿……

[来自[url=https://lezliz.itch.io/catgirly-romantic-parody-gayme]itch.io[/url]]
